description: Hospital maps found by hand on hospitals' own websites outside the UK, merged into data/world/plan-candidates.json by scripts/world/discover-plans.mjs. This is the way in for a map a crawler cannot reach (a site behind a bot challenge, navigation built in script, a hospital whose OpenStreetMap entry has no website) and the record of what a person checked. Entries are classified exactly like discovered ones, from their link text and filename. THESE ARE THE HOSPITALS' COPYRIGHT: listing one here reviews it, it does not import it.
howToAdd: Find the document in a browser and check it is genuinely a map of the hospital. Record the ISO country, the hospital's id from data/world/hospitals/<CC>.json (search the file by name), the URL as the hospital's site serves it, the link text the page uses or a short honest description (the classifier reads it: say 'floor maps' when it is one), and in the note what the map covers, when it is dated and anything a reviewer should know.

maps.linkText: Mercy Hospital – Unity Campus floor maps
maps.note: Lower level and main level, a page each: lobby, surgical services, radiation therapy, auditorium, cardiac rehab, cafeteria, gift shop, information desks at the main and emergency entrances. Copyright line says 2017. Allina Health runs a dozen hospitals on this one site.

maps.linkText: Tanner Medical Center/Villa Rica floor maps
maps.note: First to third floors: information desk, cafeteria, outpatient registration, diagnostic imaging and the main and outpatient entrances on the first; emergency department, cath lab, ICU and med/surg rooms 201–222 on the second; nursery on the third. A 2025 edition (TMCVR-All-Floors-2025.pdf, adding a chapel, a clinical decision unit, labour and delivery and rooms 301–316) was only seen on the hospital's staging host, stg.tanner.org. Campus maps for 2024 and 2025 sit beside it at upload/docs/Maps/.

maps.hospitalName: St. Peter's Health Regional Medical Center
maps.note: Linked from /patients-visitors/parking-and-facility-maps. First floor: admitting, gift shop, diagnostic imaging. Second: surgical and oncology. Third: medical, rooms 3101–3136. Fourth: women's and children's, rooms 4107–4132. The same page links single-floor maps of the 1st and 2nd floors.

maps.hospitalName: St. Peter's Health Regional Medical Center
maps.note: Second floor alone: emergency department and emergency entrance, ICU, lab, chapel, behavioural health unit.

maps.linkText: Stillwater Medical Center public floor maps (2025)
maps.note: First floor; second floor (Heart & Vascular Institute registration, Maternal Child Health, Women's Health Center, a NICU); third to fifth floors (ICU, joint replacement centre). Legend marks restrooms, lifts, waiting areas and public hallways. A 2020 edition is at /sites/default/files/inline-files/SM_PublicFloorMaps_2020.pdf with different second-floor occupants.
Hospital and education centre maps with routes from the first-floor main entrance (North Tower, SW 9th and Horne) to the surgery centre and classrooms. 1500 SW 10th Ave.

maps.linkText: Mills-Peninsula Medical Center campus map, first through fifth floors
maps.note: One sheet with a visitor circulation key covering the first to fifth floors; the lower level is not to scale. Sutter Health runs more than twenty hospitals on this one site.
Visitor floor guide with an elevator guide, published May 2026.

maps.linkText: Maria Fareri Children's Hospital floor plan map
maps.note: Three pages: main/1st floor (main entrance and lobby, paediatric and adult emergency departments, operating room, radiology, PACU, gift shop, café, conference rooms A and B); 2nd floor (trauma ICU, NICU, PICU); 3rd floor (child life, non-invasive cardiology, themed neighbourhoods with room ranges). Legend for entrances, corridors, restrooms and lifts. 100 Woods Road.

maps.linkText: Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford floor-by-floor wayfinding maps
maps.note: Main Building (Land theme) and West Building (Ocean theme), basement to the upper floors, each floor with its own colour and animal; the buildings join by a bridge on Level 1. Linked from /en/patient-family-resources/finding-your-way; Spanish edition at /content/dam/sch/content-public/pdf/wayfinding-maps-spanish-stanford-childrens.pdf. The West lobby entrance closes from 1 February 2026 for about two years.

Main hospital, ground to fourth floor, and the Bedford lobby (Deuble Heart & Vascular Hospital, Birth Center; the emergency department entrance is on Bedford Avenue). A simplified March 2022 edition is at /assets/Patients-/Aultman-Floor-Plans_Simplified_March-2022.pdf and a campus map at /assets/Patients-and-Visitors/Visitors/Parking-and-Maps/2023-Simple-Campus-Map.pdf.

maps.hospitalName: University of Washington Medical Center – Montlake
maps.linkText: UWMC floor maps for patients and visitors (November 2019)
maps.note: Floors of the main hospital, the Surgery Pavilion and the towers. Published on UW Medicine's patient-education site (healthonline.washington.edu, record uwmc-floor-maps), not on uwmedicine.org; the record says the maps are revised twice a year, so look for a newer edition. The hospital was not in the OpenStreetMap list for the US when this was recorded; add its id when the list is refreshed.

maps.linkText: Brigham and Women's Hospital main campus map and elevator directory (English, Spanish, Arabic)
maps.note: Campus map with an elevator directory. Served from the parent system's domain, massgeneralbrigham.org; brighamandwomens.org links to it from /about-bwh/locations/boston-main-campus-map.

Outdoor campus map carrying the lettered, colour-coded building system the interior signage uses (desks are named like A31). The same map is also served without an extension at /-/scassets/files/org/patients-visitors/visitors/campus-map, which the classifier cannot see.

maps.linkText: Northwestern Medicine Northwestern Memorial Hospital medical campus map
maps.note: Campus map numbering the entrances (main drive-through at 251 East Huron, emergency department at 250 East Erie), the Prentice and Galter pavilions, the Lurie Cancer Center. Spanish edition at the same path with -es.

maps.linkText: Rush University Medical Center campus map (June 2017)
maps.note: Street-level 'getting around' map: restrooms, registration, gift shop, parking office. Dated 22 June 2017.

maps.linkText: Johns Hopkins Medicine East Baltimore campus map (May 2018)
maps.note: Campus map with a building index on a grid: main entrance, Blalock, Bloomberg Children's Center, Sheikh Zayed Tower, Weinberg, Rubenstein. A near-identical copy is at /-/media/radiology/_docs/jhm_radiology_map.pdf.

Booklet with a location key: the downtown campus (Mayo, Gonda and Charlton buildings, Mayo Clinic Hospital Methodist Campus, osm-w74380141) and the Saint Marys Campus ten blocks west, with the subway and skyway links. Served from mayo.edu; mayoclinic.org links to it from the campus-buildings-maps pages. A March 2024 site map of the Saint Marys buildings (Domitilla, Mary Brigh, Generose, Francis, Alfred, Joseph, Nasseff Tower) is at https://ce.mayo.edu/sites/default/files/media/2024-03/Downtown%20Map.pdf.
